Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Introduction
The document was prepared by Eng. Mansour Mohamed Soliman, reviewed and tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, and approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa
Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal, and approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and the company coordinator for the
This document sets out the steps for repairing the fault of the boiler feed pump trip indicating signal for unit No. 2 not appearing on the Boiler Panel, and the switch indicating lamp on the Control Desk; these procedures are carried out when a fault occurs in the trip indicating signal of the electric feed pump of unit No. 2 | 
Safety Precautions
Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department
Tools and Equipment Used
Insulating plastic gloves, Avometer
New contactor, identical to the faulty one in terms of connection points and connection time
Flat long-nose pliers, ordinary pliers, 6 inch
Ordinary screwdriver 3 × 100 mm, ordinary screwdriver 6 × 150 mm
Wire stripper, test wire 2 × 20 mm
Insulating plastic gloves, Avometer
New contactor, identical to the faulty one in terms of connection points and connection time
Flat long-nose pliers, ordinary pliers, 6 inch
Ordinary screwdriver 3 × 100 mm, ordinary screwdriver 6 × 150 mm
Wire stripper, test wire 2 × 20 mm
Procedures to be Carried Out
Inspect the control circuit of the electric feed pump 2, No. (MK169-1201) | 1.
Test the contactor (d2) by isolating one terminal of the 110 V DC supply and test the points (1, 2), (3, 4), (5, 6), (7, 8); determine which points have a bad contact, and test the operation of the timer for connecting points (7, 8). | 2.
Place the pump switch in the
If the switch lamp is not lit, check that 110 V DC is reaching
Make a short circuit across points (7, 8) and observe the appearance of the Pump Off signal | 5.
If the signal does not appear, check that 110 V DC is reaching points (7, 8) | 6.
